name: Netdata
description: Instant, per-second metrics for systems and apps with auto-detecting dashboards — no configuration required.
compose:
services:
  netdata:
    image: netdata/netdata:latest
    pid: host
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:19999"
    cap_add:
      - SYS_PTRACE
      - SYS_ADMIN
    volumes:
      - /proc:/host/proc:ro
      - /sys:/host/sys:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./data:/var/lib/netdata
    restart: unless-stopped
